target: VIS/TVCG or CHI/TOCHI; neutral quantitative style
community: visual analytics / human-computer interaction, GPU tooling secondary

heatmap.encoding: binary numerical-check violation, red=failed; not absolute error magnitude
heatmap.note: Nonfinite poisoned outputs count as failed; these are intentionally injected missing writes.

performance.scope: CUDA event interval per launch, repeated resident inputs
performance.interval: 95% paired bootstrap, within one device session only
performance.baseline: experiment-authored naive FP32 kernel; not cuBLAS
